exporting staging to ledgerline-exports-dev since 2026-09-01 (dry_run=True)
export.py: error: argument --since: invalid fromisoformat value: 'bad'

I added `--since DATE` to `scripts/export.py`. It takes a `YYYY-MM-DD` date and rejects anything else. The script only prints its settings, so the date isn't used for filtering yet.

I ran it against staging with `--dry-run` only:

```
exporting staging to ledgerline-exports-dev since 2026-09-01 (dry_run=True)
```

I didn't run it without `--dry-run`. A stored memory says staging's `EXPORT_BUCKET` points at the prod bucket, and that the script should never run against staging without `--dry-run`. In this shell `EXPORT_BUCKET` wasn't set, so it fell back to the dev bucket name. That means the run doesn't show what staging would really use. A real staging run would need your go-ahead, and ideally the bucket fixed first.

I also confirmed that a bad date like `--since bad` gives a clear argparse error.
